searchText: `hash of the post state after transaction execution` -- what does this mean exactly? what is hashed and using what hashing algorithm? (it's written here <https://github.com/ethereum/tests/blob/develop/docs/test_types/TestStructures/GeneralStateTests/post.rst>) it's the root hash of the merkle tree of the state after the transaction is executed. hmm, but the whole state is not known right? i thought the pre and env only partially constrained it The pre is the whole state the whole *account state the other information needed to execute a state test filler and produce a filled test-case is contained in: * env * a fork configuration (e.g. London in the example output). Each entry in the output list for a given fork configuration corresponds to a unique tuple from data/gas/value (these can form a test matrix based on how they are defined in the test filler).

excerpts.author: jwasinger
excerpts.content:
the other information needed to execute a state test filler and produce a filled test-case is contained in: 
* env
* a fork configuration (e.g. London in the example output).  Each entry in the output list for a given fork configuration corresponds to a unique tuple from data/gas/value (these can form a test matrix based on how they are defined in the test filler).
